DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They have active summons and meet single-target planning or ongoing add phases, combined with any of the following:
  • Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining, and they’ve talented it
  • Army of the Dead is active with Abomination (<18sec remaining) or Army Ghouls (≤18sec remaining)
  • No Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents: Dark Transformation is active
  • No active Gargoyle, and its cooldown (+10sec) exceeds Power Infusion’s duration
  • 3+ enemies present with Dark Transformation active or Death and Decay area active
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform and the buff isn’t active,
  • They activate Dark Ascension and the buff isn’t active, or
  • They have the TWW Season 2 4-piece set bonus active and the buff isn’t active.
